data.body: Implementation landed: Gerrit change 1243 MERGED (verified via /a/changes/1243/detail: LLM-Review +1 rebar-review-bot, Verified +1 rebar-ci-bot on ps2 — ps1's Verified -1 was the pre-1238 pip-audit block, resolved by rebase). Delivered per the signed plan: src/rebar/review_bot/retrigger.py (recheck-review token, stem-based classify_tag over all production tag shapes incl. merge-change suffix inside the brackets, fail-open on unparseable, refuse ONLY a real finding BLOCK), gerrit_client get_change_messages + post_comment (message-only body, no labels key — vote-free invariant), app.py comment-added worker routing + /rerun attempts-budget reset (harmonized semantics), webhooks.config comment-added event, docs/review-policy.md + CONTRIBUTING.md \u00a72c + runbook updates, 31 unit tests (all passing incl. fastapi-dependent ones). OPERATOR ACTION REQUIRED for activation: re-run infra/gerrit/service-user.sh to push the updated webhooks.config (comment-added subscription) to refs/meta/config — until then the trigger is inert. Worktree fast-forwarded to gerrit/main b1d28ceb18 containing the rebar-ticket: bb9b commit.
